text: Your AI can now spend your money.
Do you know what happens when ChatGPT gets your wallet?
OpenAI just launched ChatGPT Wallet in the U.S.
You tell the AI what you want... and it actually buys it for you.
It never sees your card number. It uses a secret token instead.
And every single purchase needs your face or fingerprint.
United Airlines, Amazon and eBay are already blocking AI shoppers.
And right now, AI agents made about five hundred food delivery orders in a whole week. Tiny.
Stores will have to choose. Let AI shoppers in... or lose them to someone who does.
The next big shopping war might not be for you. It might be for your AI.
Would you let AI buy stuff for you?
